text:
erin: quick a11y flag from the models table review: bulk-select toolbar doesn't announce how many items are selected to VoiceOver/NVDA when you use Shift+click or Shift+Arrow.
noah: i saw that too. screen readers hear checkboxes toggle but theres no summary announcement. also selected row background uses #F0F7FF with text #0C2A4B -> contrast ~3.8:1 for body text.
dara: is the list implemented as a <table> or role=grid? that matters for aria-multiselectable and selection events.
miles: it's a table with checkboxes in the first column. we never set aria-selected on the rows or an aria-live region for bulk changes.
aria-bot: auto-a11y-scan(models-table-2409876543): failures: 3 (missing aria-selected, missing live announcement for bulk select, low contrast on selected text). full report: https://ci.internal/a11y/models/2409876543
erin: minimal fixes proposal:
- add aria-selected="true|false" to the <tr> when its checkbox state changes
- mark table as role="grid" aria-multiselectable="true" to enable range selection semantics
- programmatically announce via aria-live polite: "3 items selected" when selection state changes via keyboard or mouse
- bump selected text color to #052548 (est contrast 4.6:1)
noah: for keyboard UX we also need Shift+Arrow support. current code handles Shift+Click range but not keyboard ranges. NVDA users expect to use Shift+Arrow to select ranges in grids.
dara: agree. implementation note: maintain a focusedCell index and when Shift is held, apply aria-selected to the range between anchor and current. ensure we only move focus, not active cell, so we don't trigger navigation.
miles: small code sketch:
```
// on keydown
if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && e.shiftKey) {
  const next = clamp(focusIndex+1)
  setRangeSelected(anchorIndex, next)
  focusCell(next)
}
```
erin: also: bulk action toolbar should be reachable by Tab and should have an aria-label like "Bulk actions, 3 selected" and update live when count changes.
aria-bot: note: NVDA sometimes reports table selection only when role=grid and aria-selected present. recommend switching semantics to grid for parity.
noah: edge case: mobile TalkBack: Shift key doesn't exist. ensure the toolbar updates on touch multi-select and announce with aria-live for mobile too.
dara: acceptance criteria for ticket INS-9012:
- NVDA and VoiceOver announce selection count after range selection via Shift+Click and Shift+Arrow
- rows have aria-selected updated on any selection change
- bulk toolbar includes dynamic accessible name with count and is keyboard-focusable
- selected text contrast >= 4.5:1
- unit + a11y-e2e tests for NVDA + VO
aria-bot: created INS-9012, priority P2, assignee @miles, linked scan and a11y-e2e job. ETA 7d.
miles: i'll pick this up. will prototype grid semantics and add Shift+Arrow tests to the keyboard suite. will include screencaps of NVDA announcing the summary.
erin: thanks — please add short video of VoiceOver after the patch. closing the thread for now. :white_check_mark:
